Proposition
[normal Jacobi field data and vanishing of the mixed curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0138 ↗ lem:pet-ch4-hess-r-derivatives On $(I imes S^{n-1},dr^2+ ho ^2(r)ds_{n-1}^2)$, \[ abla _X\partial _r= egin{cases} \dfrac {\partial _r ho }{ ho }X& X ext{ tangent to }S^{n-1},\[4pt]0& X=\partial _r,\end{cases} \qquad R(X,\partial _r)\partial _r= egin{cases} -\dfrac {\partial _r^2 ho }{ ho }X& X ext{ tangent to }S^{n-1},\[4pt]0& X=\partial _r,\end{cases} \] and the mixed curvature vanishes: $ abla _X\mathrm{II}=0$ for $\mathrm{II}=\mathrm{Hess}\, r$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch4-rotsym-radial-jacobi \sketch The formulas for $ abla _X\partial _r$ and $R(X,\partial _r)\partial _r$ follow directly from subsection 2.3 and subsection 2.3 by definition of the second fundamental form and radial curvature. For the mixed curvature, since $\mathrm{II}= frac {\partial _r ho }{ ho }g_r$ and the coefficient $\partial _r ho / ho $ depends only on $r$ (a function constant on each level set of $r$), for $X$ tangent to a level set, $ abla _X\mathrm{II}=D_X(\partial _r ho / ho )\, g_r+ frac {\partial _r ho }{ ho } abla _Xg_r=0+0=0$, since $D_X(\partial _r ho / ho )=0$ ($X$ is tangent to the level set on which $\partial _r ho / ho $ is constant) and $ abla _Xg_r=0$ ($g_r$ is parallel along its own level sets by metric compatibility).
